Prose body. The five wrong CLOSED nested values above each render exit 1 under
`quarto render` 1.7.33: `execute.echo: maybe` (closed boolean+fenced),
`execute.eval: banana` (closed boolean), `format.html.toc: yes` and
`format.html.number-sections: yes` (closed booleans), `format.html.df-print: banana`
(closed enum non-member). The rest render exit 0 and must NEVER be flagged:
`execute.output: banana` (OPEN anyOf free arm), `execute.daemon: 30` (OPEN
boolean-or-number — the numeric slice's job), `format.html.theme: banana` (OPEN free
string), `format.html.notarealoption: yes` (UNKNOWN key). Nested resolution reuses
the completion provider's own lookup, inverted (nested value-validation plan §3.4).
